description: Simulate the project with iterb (same engine and translation as the desktop app). With plan: run a SimScenarioPlan JSON file (steps with inputs and assertions on native outputs; result data.scenario is the desktop SimScenarioResult, failures exit 4). Without: a free run reporting serial and outputs. scenario: a legacy YAML scenario, converted to a plan.

duration.description: Free-run or legacy-scenario length, e.g. "5s" or "2000ms" (not with plan).

plan.description: SimScenarioPlan JSON file path (e.g. sim/smoke.plan.json), relative to the project.

projectPath.description: Absolute path to the IterxAI project directory (contains iterx.json). Defaults to the server cwd.

scenario.description: Legacy scenario file path (sim/*.yaml|*.json), converted to a SimScenarioPlan.

name: sim_run
